A general of the ^1/Kingdom of Cornia^, ^2/Valmore^,
suddenly rebelled and attacked ^3/Castle Gran Corrine^, the capital.
Besieged, Queen ^4/Ilenia^ ordered ^7/Josef^, a
^6/Holy Knight^, to escape with her son ^5/Alain^.
She then rode into battle, knowing it was reckless.

^2/Ilenia^ faced ^1/Valmore^, who said he fought to
reclaim lost land. ^4/Ilenia^ and her retainers
made their final stand against ^3/Valmore^ and
fell.

^2/Josef^ escaped the encirclement with ^1/Alain^.
^3/Valmore^ won the rebellion and the ^4/capital^ fell.
With ^5/Cornia^ in his grip, ^6/Valmore^ began his next
plan.

Claiming descent from the ^2/ancient Zenoiran Empire^, ^1/Valmore^ took the name Emperor ^3/Galerius^ and began invading the surrounding lands. One nation after another fell despite fierce resistance, and within ten years all of ^4/Fevrith^ was under the rule of the ^5/Zenoiran Empire^.

The queen of ^1/Cornia^, skilled in both statecraft
and warfare. She ruled the great kingdom of
^2/Cornia^ with dignity and without major turmoil.
When she saw the rebellion could not be stopped,
she entrusted ^3/Alain^ to ^4/Josef^ and fell
fighting ^5/Galerius^ in the capital.

— A Somber Reunion —
When ^1/Alain^ defeated ^2/Galerius^,
the fallen emperor's body transformed
into Ilenia's.
But her eyes never opened again.

— Unicorn Overlord —
Ilenia had not died in battle; ^1/Galerius^ had taken
over her body when she struck him down. When
^2/Baltro^ summoned ^3/Galerius's^ soul to the ^4/Beyond^,
Ilenia was able to regain her own mind and body.

Having been saved by ^1/Alain^, her weakened
body soon recovered, and she made her survival known
throughout Cornia. She urged the regional lords to support
^2/Alain^ as the new king. After abdicating, she is said
to have lived a peaceful life in retirement.

A former general of ^1/Cornia^. Though born to poor nobility, his imposing build and leadership won him victories and a general's rank. He later rebelled, destroyed ^2/Cornia^ and called himself ^4/Galerius^, a descendant of the ^3/Zenoiran Empire^.

A former knight of ^1/Cornia^. During
^2/Valmore's rebellion^ ten years ago,
Queen ^3/Ilenia^ entrusted ^4/Alain^ to him.
He escaped to ^5/Palevia^, bearing the title
of ^6/Holy Knight^.

After escaping to ^1/Palevia^, he sought to restore
^2/Cornia^. He formed an underground resistance
against ^3/Zenoira^, carefully waiting for a chance
to rise. When the ^4/Zenoiran Army^ launched its
^5/attack on Palevia^, he left with ^6/Alain^ and formed
the ^7/Cornian Liberation Army^.

With ^1/Alain^, Josef seized ^2/#FN(C5北の町)^, earning
the ^3/Cornian Liberation Army^ its first great victory.
It was the fruit of years of preparation
after they fled the ^5/capital^ with young
^4/Alain^.

He survived the ^2/battle for the capital^ with ^1/Alain^ and fulfilled his duty to the ^3/Liberation^. Without Josef, ^4/Alain^ would not have survived and ^5/Cornia^ could not have been restored. He was credited with the greatest service and later called the Holy Knight of Fevrith.

An honor for knights of the
^1/Kingdom of Cornia^ who excel in combat,
learning and character. Several fellow knights
must recommend them, and the king must
personally approve. A sword and shield are
awarded with the title.

A knight of the fallen kingdom of ^1/Cornia^ and trusted aide to Queen ^2/Ilenia^. During ^3/Valmore's rebellion^, he fought beside ^4/Ilenia^ against ^5/Valmore^, but was defeated and taken prisoner.

Under ^1/magick of control^, he served as a
knight of the ^2/Zenoiran Empire^ and led
the secret ^3/attack on Palevia^. When
^4/Alain^ defeated him, ^5/Alain's ring^ broke
the ^6/magick of control^, restoring Hodrick.

Fighting beside ^1/Alain^, he seized
^2/#FN(C5北の町)^ and raised the
^3/Cornian Liberation Army^’s standing. He guaranteed
the safety of local nobles and secured the
city center early.

He survived the ^2/battle for the capital^ with ^1/Alain^
and fulfilled his duty to the ^3/Liberation^. After
^4/Alain^ defeated ^5/Galerius^, his precise orders kept
the castle’s capture under control despite
^6/Zenoira^’s bloodshed.

Emperor of the reborn ^1/Zenoiran Empire^,
formerly ^3/Valmore^, a celebrated ^2/Cornian^
general. He suddenly staged a ^4/rebellion^,
killed Queen ^5/Ilenia^, his liege, abolished
^6/Cornia^ and founded the new ^7/Zenoiran Empire^.

He had ^1/Renault^ abduct ^2/Scarlett^ and
took her away to break the seal
on the ^3/Sanctuary^. He fell to the ^4/Liberation^,
but ^5/Baltro^ broke the seal
and revived Galerius.

Restored to full power, Galerius defeated
^1/Alain^ with a single blow, demonstrating
his strength. He declared that he would
fulfill his duty as king, then departed
with ^2/Baltro^.

— An Age of Darkness —
Though defeated by the ^2/Liberation Army^ in
the ^1/battle for the capital^, Galerius tricked
^3/Alain^ into delivering the final blow and took
over his body. What happened to the ^4/world^
afterward remains unknown.

— The Overlord, Defeated —
Defeated by the ^2/Liberation Army^ in the
^1/battle for the capital^, Galerius had ^3/Alain^
strike the final blow and seized his body.
But the prayers of those bound by the ^4/rite^ and
the power of the ^5/ring^ thwarted him,
and he vanished.

— Unicorn Overlord —
Defeated by the ^2/Liberation Army^ in the
^1/battle for the capital^, he tried and failed to
seize ^3/Alain's^ body. ^4/Baltro^ then used his
soul to complete the rite, destroying Galerius.

Baltro's exceptional command of magic is said
to have contributed greatly to ^1/Galerius's rebellion^
in Cornia and the expansion of the new
^2/Zenoiran Empire^.

After ^2/Scarlett^ was abducted by ^1/Renault^, Baltro broke the seal inside the ruins called the ^3/sanctuary^. When ^5/Galerius^—thought to have been defeated by ^4/Alain^ and the others—revived with tremendous power, Baltro used magic to teleport away with him.

Baltro later confronted the ^2/Liberation Army^
in ^1/Elheim^. Using necromancy, he turned the
^4/elves^ and ^5/dark elves^ living in the
^3/Forest of Thorns^ into undead soldiers
to fight the ^6/Liberation Army^.

Cornered after a fierce battle with the
^1/Liberation Army^, Baltro bound ^2/Alain^ with
an ancient curse and tried to kill him alongside
^3/Eltolinde^. ^4/Alcina^ intervened, freeing
^5/Alain^, who struck Baltro down. The sorcerer's
body then dissolved like mist.

When ^3/Galerius^ fell in the ^1/Liberation Army's^
^2/battle for the capital^, Baltro used his soul
to open a gate linking the ^4/Beyond^ with the
^5/world of the living^. Through this rite, he made
souls from the ^6/Beyond^ manifest as a different form
of power in the ^7/living world^.

Baltro then fought ^1/Alain^ using soul-powered
necromancy, putting the ^2/Liberation Army^ in
jeopardy. Answering ^3/Alain's^ call, the souls
passed through the gate back to the ^4/Beyond^.
The ^5/Six Sages^ closed the gate, and the power
of the ^6/Ring of the Unicorn^ destroyed Baltro's soul.

What Baltro hoped to achieve by opening the gate and transforming souls into another power remains unclear. The only records say that he tried to resurrect an ancient magical beast to create a new form of life.

The lands and seas that people recognize as
the world. The main continent is home to
^1/Cornia^, ^2/Drakenhold^, ^3/Elheim^ and
^4/Bastorias^, while ^5/Albion^ occupies a smaller
continent. The seas surrounding them are
thought to complete the world.

— The Overlord, Defeated —
Prince ^1/Alain^ defeated ^2/Galerius^ and
reclaimed ^3/Gran Corrine^. As Cornia's new king,
he worked to stabilize his devastated realm
while remaining vigilant against the remnants
of the ^4/Zenoiran Army^.

Remnants of the ^1/Zenoiran Army^ continued to appear across the land. ^2/Alain^ repeatedly tried to wipe them out, but never managed to kill the old man believed to be their leader. After ^3/Alain's^ death, ^4/Fevrith^ is said to have once again entered an age of war between nations.

— Unicorn Overlord —
Prince ^1/Alain^ defeated ^2/Galerius^ and
reclaimed ^3/Gran Corrine^. With Queen ^4/Ilenia^
revealed to be alive, the regional lords pledged
their support to the Cornian royal family. ^5/Alain^
then eliminated the remnants of the ^6/Zenoiran Army^.

With support at home and abroad secured,
^1/Ilenia^ abdicated in favor of ^2/Alain^, who became king.
^3/Alain^
restored Cornia's strength and upheld the bonds
forged with other nations during the ^4/Liberation^.
His reign was its most peaceful in history.

A southeastern kingdom spanning mountains and
^1/desert^, rich in mineral resources. Its distinctive
army centered on wyverns, but ^2/Zenoira^ defeated it
and killed the king. His two sons, both potential
heirs, went missing.

A verdant land in southwestern ^1/Fevrith^, home to ^2/elves^ and ^3/dark elves^. Its distinctive government is headed by a ^4/priestess^, and it was protected by a barrier. Yet the ^5/Zenoiran Empire^ invaded, and after the ^6/capital^ fell, the ^7/priestess^ decided to surrender.

The ^1/Liberation^ and ^2/Rosalinde^ joined
Elheim's forces to free ^3/Laurhal^ from the
^4/Zenoiran Army^ and ^5/Eltolinde^ from the
^6/magick of control^. Eltolinde joined the
^7/Liberation^ to fight the ^8/Zenoiran Army^.

The ^1/Liberation^ joined ^2/Eltolinde^ and ^3/Rosalinde^ to
destroy the ^4/Zenoiran Army^’s southern forces.
They expelled the main ^5/Zenoiran Army^ forces from
Elheim, allowing the country to begin
rebuilding.

A land of ^2/bestrals^ spanning the cold north of
^1/Fevrith^. Clan leaders decide major matters; there
is no king. Though powerful ^3/bestrals^ defended it,
the ^4/Zenoiran Empire^ conquered almost the entire
region.

The bestral clans rallied around the ^1/Frostblooms^
to resist ^2/Zenoira^, but struggled. With ^3/Bastoritza^
retaken and aid from the ^4/Cornian Liberation Army^,
the tide turned. They finally destroyed the
^5/Zenoiran Army's^ main northern force.

For the time being, Bastorias will continue
to be governed by a council of ^1/bestral^ clan
leaders. But there are plans to appoint a king
to unite the ^2/bestrals^.

An island theocracy in western ^1/Fevrith^, ruled
by the ^2/Palevian Orthodoxy^. It is the center
of the ^3/Palevian Orthodoxy^, whose influence extends
across the world. Even after surrendering to the
^4/Zenoiran Empire^, it retains nominal self-rule.

As the ^1/Liberation Army^ advanced, Albion's
anti-Zenoiran resistance joined the
^2/Liberation Army^. ^4/Nigel^ of the
^3/Knights of the Sacred Heart^ also helped.
The ^6/Liberation Army^ won the
^5/battle for #FN(A6首都)^, returning sovereignty
to the ^7/Orthodoxy^.

A vast empire once said to have ruled most of
^1/Fevrith^. Its advanced technology, especially
its magical arts, far surpassed anything
known today. Yet it is said to have vanished
suddenly, in the span of a single day.

After ^3/Valmore^ destroyed ^2/Cornia^ in the
^1/rebellion^, he declared a new Zenoiran Empire.
^4/Valmore^ then took the name Emperor ^5/Galerius^ and
invaded every nation, conquering them in rapid
succession.

A vast empire now ruling every nation, with
^1/Galerius^ at its head. Its rule is harsh, but
the severity varies between regions and lords.
Resistance groups and remnants of the old
national armies still survive throughout the land.

— The Overlord, Defeated — When ^1/Galerius^ was slain by ^3/Alain^ of the ^2/Liberation Army^, the chain of command broke down and the ^4/Zenoiran Army^ collapsed across the continent. But even afterward, an elderly hooded man is said to have led remnants of the ^5/Zenoiran Army^ and repeatedly started new wars.

— Unicorn Overlord —
When ^1/Galerius^ fell to ^3/Alain^ of the
^2/Liberation Army^, the chain of command broke
and the ^4/Zenoiran Army^ collapsed everywhere.
Though accounts differ on when ^5/Zenoira^ fell,
most date its end to ^6/Galerius's^ defeat.

The armed forces of the ^1/Zenoiran Empire^.
Under ^2/Galerius^ are his personal knights,
their knightly order and his direct army,
along with regional forces stationed in
each conquered nation.

Besides the army directly controlled from
^1/Gran Corrine^, there are three major forces:
the southern army holding ^2/Drakenhold^ and
^3/Elheim^, the northern army holding ^4/Bastorias^,
and the western army holding ^5/Albion^. Each
includes soldiers from the conquered countries.

To control its vast territories, Zenoira uses
wealth seized from conquered nations to hire
mercenary and bandit bands. Many serve the
empire for a valuable privilege: the right
to collect taxes from assigned towns and villages.

A tall, slender, long-eared race common in
^1/Elheim^. Said to be the oldest people of
^2/Fevrith^, they comprise elves and ^3/dark elves^.
Elves in particular are known for their
dexterity and skill with bows.

A race of humanoid beasts living mainly in ^1/Bastorias^.
Its bloodlines include ^2/lion bestrals^, ^3/bear bestrals^,
^4/wolf bestrals^, ^5/owl bestrals^, ^6/fox bestrals^,
^7/goat bestrals^, ^8/cat bestrals^ and ^9/rat bestrals^,
which vary in strength and population.

A rare ^1/bestral^ people with lion heads and
human bodies. Strong and agile even among
^2/bestrals^, they are said to have once produced
a king of the ^3/bestrals^. Though they dealt
the ^4/Zenoiran Army^ heavy losses, they were almost
wiped out.

A ^1/bestral^ bloodline resembling bears. As the
strongest and heartiest of all ^2/bestrals^, they served
well in the resistance against the ^3/Zenoiran Army^. They
are the least common bestral bloodline after the
^4/lion bestrals^, but can be found throughout ^5/Bastorias^.

A ^1/bestral^ people resembling wolves. Many
become mercenaries, using their agility and
physique in swordplay. Others find work
throughout the land that makes use of
their nimble hands.

A ^1/bestral^ people resembling foxes, noted
for powerful legs and remarkable speed.
Many work as mercenaries, using their swiftness
and spear skills taught from childhood as
part of their traditional martial arts.

A mild-mannered ^1/bestral^ people resembling
goats, generally ill-suited to warfare.
Many
work as farmers, merchants or craftsmen.

A small ^1/bestral^ people resembling cats.
Though not suited to combat,
they excel
at catching fish.

A ^1/bestral^ bloodline resembling rats. As the weakest
of all ^2/bestral^ bloodlines, they have spent much of
their history oppressed and downtrodden. So,
they rarely make themselves known, even to other
^3/bestrals^.

Having fled to ^1/Palevia Island^, ^2/Alain^ grew into a fine young man of 17, living peacefully while honing his swordsmanship. But that life ended the day a suspicious ship flying ^3/Zenoiran^ colors entered the harbor.

Soldiers disembark one after another from a
^2/Zenoiran^ ship docked on ^1/Palevia^. They are
led by ^4/Hodrick^, formerly a knight in the
personal guard of ^3/Queen Ilenia^.

^1/Alain's^ childhood friend, priestess ^2/Scarlett^,
was attacked by ^3/Zenoiran^ troops while praying.
^4/Alain^ saved her at the cathedral, and they
joined ^5/Josef^ before hurrying to the harbor.

^2/Josef^ tries to execute ^1/Hodrick^, who shows
no trace of his former loyalty. ^3/Alain^ stops
him, and his ^4/ring^ suddenly shines. Restored
to his senses, ^5/Hodrick^ reveals that ^6/Galerius^
can control people's minds with magic.

Crown prince of the fallen kingdom of ^1/Cornia^,
and son of its queen, ^2/Ilenia^. After losing his
mother ^4/Ilenia^ in ^3/Valmore's rebellion^, he was taken
to the isle of ^6/Palevia^ by ^5/Josef^. There, ^7/Josef^ taught
him sword and strategy until the age of 17.

After the ^1/Zenoiran Army's^ ^2/attack on Palevia^, he left the island, raised the ^3/Liberation Army^ and became its commander. Pledging to defeat the ^4/Zenoiran Empire^ and restore ^5/Cornia^, he went on to lead liberation campaigns across the land.

Leading the ^1/Liberation Army^, Alain attacked and captured the heavily defended ^4/#FN(C5北の町)^ in ^3/Cornia^ from the ^2/Zenoiran Army^, and safely rescued ^5/Scarlett^. The feat spread the names of Alain and the ^6/Cornian Liberation Army^ even further.

After a fierce battle, he and ^1/Gilbert^ succeeded
in reclaiming ^3/#FN(D5城)^, the seat of
^2/Drakenhold^ royalty, from the ^4/Zenoiran Army^.
Leaving the reconstruction of ^5/Drakenhold^ to
its people, he and the ^6/Liberation^ marched on.

With ^1/Yahna's^ help, Alain passes through the
^3/Winding Wood^ of ^2/Elheim^. He is joined by
^5/Rosalinde^, the kingdom's ^4/augur^.
With her information, he captures ^6/Laurhal^,
frees ^7/Eltolinde^ from the ^8/magick of control^
and welcomes her into the ^9/Liberation Army^.

Afterward, Alain continued fighting the ^2/Zenoiran Army^ in ^1/Elheim^, defeating forces led by ^3/Gailey^, ^4/Baltro^ and ^5/Alcina^. As a result, he eliminated the main force of the southern ^6/Zenoiran Army^ and successfully liberated ^7/Elheim^.

Alain advances into ^1/Bastorias^. Despite the
harsh snowbound march and difficult battles
against formidable ^2/bestrals^, he defeats
commander ^3/Reimann^ and his successor ^4/Elgor^.
The northern army is destroyed, and
^5/Bastorias^ is liberated.

Alain also crossed into ^1/Albion^, where he fought both the occupying ^2/Zenoiran Army^ and Albion's own forces. Despite difficult battles against ^4/Albion's^ knights, known as ^3/angels^, he captured ^5/Bisfaine Cathedral^ and revealed that the ^6/pontifex^ was already dead.

— Succumbed to Evil —
After defeating ^2/Galerius^ in the
^1/battle for the capital^, Alain saw ^3/Galerius^ change
into ^4/Ilenia^. Alain then transformed into ^5/Galerius^
as if possessed, losing control of his own body.

— The Overlord, Defeated —
After a fierce ^1/battle for the capital^, Alain
defeats ^2/Galerius^, only to have his body
seized by ^3/Galerius^. The prayers of the
ritual's participants bring Alain back.
He destroys ^4/Galerius's^ soul and retakes ^5/Cornia^.

After reclaiming ^1/Gran Corrine^, he ascended the throne of ^2/Cornia^. While working to stabilize the country, he remained vigilant throughout his life against the elusive remnants of the ^3/Zenoiran Army^. Later generations called him the Unicorn Overlord.

— Unicorn Overlord —
After defeating ^2/Galerius^ in the fierce
^1/battle for the capital^, Alain attempts to
free his soul, ultimately recovering his mother
^3/Ilenia's^ body. He then returns to battle
to defeat ^4/Baltro^, who has opened the gate.

In his final battle with ^1/Baltro^, Alain calls
to the people of Zenoira: if they still have
hearts, they should answer him. With their
help and that of the ^2/Six Sages^, he uses
the ^3/Ring of the Unicorn^ to destroy ^4/Baltro^.

Though Alain possessed no ability by which
to communicate with Zenoira's lost souls,
the ^1/Ring of the Unicorn^ and the gate
to the Beyond opened by ^2/Baltro^ likely
made it possible.

After reclaiming ^1/Gran Corrine^, he wiped out the remaining ^2/Zenoiran Army^ forces within the country. ^3/Ilenia^ abdicated in his favor, and he became the new king of ^4/Cornia^, proclaiming the restoration of the ^5/Kingdom of Cornia^ at home and abroad. Later generations called him the Unicorn Overlord.

A ring bearing the ^1/Unicorn^ emblem,
passed down through Cornia's royal family.
Only royals are said to unleash its cleansing
power. Held before someone under the
^2/magick of control^, it breaks the spell
and restores their original personality.

The Ring of the Unicorn is said to hold
a sealed 'true power.'
The key to
breaking that seal lies in ^1/Elheim^.

The ring is paired with the ^3/Ring of the Maiden^
held by ^1/Elheim's^ ^2/priestess^. The ^4/rite of
covenant^ can be performed when the two
ring-bearers sincerely trust the partners
they have chosen, and that trust is mutual.

Magick employed by the ^1/Zenoiran Army^ to shackle
the minds of their enemies. Those affected lose
any semblance of free will, and—once released—
are left with little more than vague memories of
the events that transpired.

The magick of control actually transfers
another person's soul into its target,
making that soul the new master of the body.
It is one of ^1/Baltro's^ necromantic arts,
but a special catalyst limits its use.

On the ^1/Isle of Palevia^ stands a cathedral of the
^2/Palevian Orthodoxy^. Few ^3/Orthodox^ clergy serve here,
but islanders treasure it as the faith's first
^4/Orthodox^ temple. Nearby stands an ^5/altar^
older than the cathedral.

Surviving the ^2/battle for the capital^ beside ^1/Alain^, this warrior fulfilled his duty to the ^3/Liberation^. From the ^4/Isle of Palevia^ to the war's end, he stood by ^5/Alain's^ side. The cheerful redhead's name lived on for ages.

The daughter of one of ^1/Josef's^ friends,
she has studied martial arts and academics
under ^2/Josef^. Though close to ^3/Alain^,
Chloe reminds herself that she is an
attendant serving the prince of ^4/Cornia^.

She helps ^1/Alain^ capture ^2/#FN(C5北の町)^
and rescue ^3/Scarlett^. Impressed by the
fighting spirit of the ^4/Knights of the Rose^,
she reconsiders her own fight against ^6/Zenoira^
beyond her role as ^5/Alain's^ attendant.

She survived the ^2/battle for the capital^ with ^1/Alain^ and fulfilled her duty to the ^3/Liberation^. ^4/Alain^ is said to have remained in good health through the final battle thanks to Chloe's meals and attentiveness. Her knowledge was later compiled into a book after the war.

from your command post.

or your units are wiped out, you can use
#c(13)Hallowed Corne Ash#/c to continue.

and #c(13)Expand Units#/c for increasing unit slots.

Honors can be earned by #c(13)completing battle stages#/c,
#c(13)making deliveries#/c, #c(13)defeating wandering enemies#/c, and more.

#c(12)- Expanding Units -#/c
Here, you can exchange Honors you've earned to
#c(13)increase the maximum size of a unit#/c or #c(13)unlock additional unit slots#/c.

#c(12)- Expanding Units -#/c
When visiting a fort, you can exchange Honors you've earned to
#c(13)increase the maximum size of a unit#/c or #c(13)unlock additional unit slots#/c.

#c(12)- Hiring Mercenaries: Class Selection -#/c
Here, you can exchange Honors to enlist new soldiers.
First, select the class of mercenary you'd like to hire to your army.

#c(12)- Hiring Mercenaries: Class Selection -#/c
When visiting a fort, you can exchange Honors to enlist new soldiers.
First, select the class of mercenary you'd like to hire to your army.

#c(12)- Hiring Mercenaries: Growth Type -#/c
Next select their name, stat growth type,
clothing and body colors.

Combining growth types changes how stats develop.
(The order of growth types 1 and 2 makes no difference.)

#c(12)- Growth Type: Defensive -#/c
A growth type focused on Defense.
Suited to front-row and non-attacking classes.

When dismissing a mercenary, their equipment will be returned to you
and you'll be refunded half of the Honors you spent to hire them.

#c(12)- Class Promotion -#/c
Here, you can spend Honors to promote
a character to the advanced version of their base class.

#c(12)- Class Promotion -#/c
At a fort, you can spend Honors to promote
a character to the advanced version of their base class.

#c(12)- Towns -#/c
Towns allow you to #c(13)purchase equipment and consumables#/c,
#c(13)deliver items#/c, #c(13)station guards#/c, and more.

When using #(3)Compare Stats to purchase a piece of equipment,
you'll be able to #c(13)immediately equip it#/c to a selected character.

#c(12)- Deliveries -#/c
Towns devastated under Zenoiran rule can be rebuilt
by making #c(13)deliveries#/c.

Materials needed for deliveries can be gathered from
#c(13)foraging sites#/c across the overworld.

#c(12)- Taverns -#/c
By eating a meal at a tavern in a walled city or castle,
you can raise the rapport between the characters dining together.

#c(12)- Walled Cities and Citadels -#/c
These facilities combine the functions of both towns and forts.
As restoration progresses, their taverns become available.

#c(12)- Baumratte Coliseum -#/c
Visit the coliseum to take part in online battles.
Single-player offline battles are also available.

#c(12)- Coliseum Rankings -#/c
Online battle #(23)rankings change depending on
Battle Points earned in ranked matches.

Battle Points reset roughly every two weeks.
You can check the current ranking results period
at the bottom of the rankings screen.

You can view your defending unit's results by selecting
Defense Records from the #(3)Battle Log menu.
Defending-unit battles will not affect your Battle Points.

Completing #c(13)battle stages#/c will liberate enemy regions,
securing the area and driving out hostile forces.

The magic circles have changed, and even in battles against phantom soldiers,
defeated units will now withdraw from the battlefield.

Viewing a rapport conversation grants a reward,
as proof that the bond between the characters has deepened.

Alain can only perform the rite of covenant with
an ally #c(13)who shares a heartfelt bond with him#/c.

#c(12)- The Rite of Covenant -#/c
Alain can only perform the rite of covenant with an ally
#c(13)who shares a heartfelt bond with him#/c. Spend time with allies to deepen rapport.

#c(12)- Luminous Corne Ash -#/c
Luminous Corne Ash holds the power of rebirth and can be
used on the overworld to #c(13)restore combatants who have retreated from battle#/c.

Combatants act in order from highest #(65)Initiative to lowest.
After everyone has acted, any combatants with #(56)#c(9)AP#/c remaining
will act again in the same Initiative order.

This is also true of skills with a conditional tactic set.
For example, an attack skill with the Cavalry condition set
will always target the closest cavalry enemy to the user.

Physical Damage = (#(61)Phys. ATK - #(62)Phys. DEF) x (Phys. Potency/100)
Magick Damage = (#(63)Mag. ATK - #(64)Mag. DEF) x (Mag. Potency/100)
Total Damage = Physical Damage + Magick Damage

#c(12)- Critical Hits -#/c
When attacking, a character may land a critical hit based on their #(68)Critical Rate,
increasing the damage dealt by a set percentage.

#c(12)- Guarding -#/c
When a character is hit by a physical attack, Guard may activate
based on their #(69)Guard Rate, reducing physical damage by a set percentage.

#c(12)- Bypassing a Guard -#/c
Guarding cannot reduce magick damage.
Against foes with a high Guard Rate, use magick or magick-imbued skills.
Buffs and debuffs wear off when the battle ends.
Afflictions such as Poison and Burn are also considered debuffs.

#c(12)- Burn -#/c
Burn deals fixed damage before the character takes an active action.
Applying Burn again increases the amount of damage.

#c(12)- Stun -#/c
A stunned character cannot act.
Stun is removed after their next turn is skipped.

#c(12)- Guard Seal -#/c
A character suffering from Guard Seal cannot guard.
Cover skills still activate, but no guard means taking more damage.

#c(12)- Ground-Based Skills -#/c
These skills can only hit targets on the ground.
#(37)Flying characters will be unaffected.

#c(12)- Classes -#/c
Each character has a set #c(13)class#/c representing their unit type.
Classes differ in their capabilities, usable equipment, and skills.

#c(12)- Classes -#/c
Each character has a set #c(13)class#/c representing their unit type.
Classes differ in their capabilities, usable equipment, and skills.

For example, as a #(37)Flying class, Gryphon Knights #c(13)halve
the accuracy of melee attacks from ground-based enemies#/c.
As such, they're better at dodging than other classes.

#c(12)- Thieves and Hunters -#/c
#c(13)Thieves#/c have naturally high Evasion
and can also use #c(13)Evade#/c to dodge incoming attacks.

#c(12)- Lord -#/c
The #c(13)Lord#/c is a class unique to Alain.
It excels at both offense and defense.

#c(12)- High Lord -#/c
The #c(13)High Lord#/c is a class unique to Alain.
It excels at powerful area attacks from horseback.

#c(12)- Fighter -#/c
#c(13)Fighters#/c are especially effective against #c(13)Hunters#/c.
Their high Defense also makes them well suited to protecting allies from the front row.

#c(12)- Fighter Strategy -#/c
High Defense makes them best suited to the #c(13)front row#/c.
#(57)Arrow Cover lets them shield allies from ranged physical attacks.

#c(12)- Viking -#/c
When promoted, Housecarls become #c(13)Vikings#/c
who excel at dealing massive damage to weakened enemies.

#c(12)- Landsknecht Strategy -#/c
#(57)Vengeful Guard #c(13)raises their attack after guarding#/c.
Their attacks grow more potent when positioned in the #c(13)front row#/c.

#c(12)- Hoplite -#/c
Boasting greatshields, armor, and high Physical Defense,
#c(13)Hoplites#/c are stout warriors that excel at protecting their allies.

#c(12)- Sniper Strategy -#/c
#(56)Row Shot lets them fire at an entire row of enemies,
allowing them to devastate flying units with a single attack.

#c(12)- Thief Strategy -#/c
Best positioned on the front row, where #(57)Evade
lets them dodge and nullify enemy attacks.

#c(12)- Rogue Strategy -#/c
#(56)Shadowbite lets them blind an entire row of enemies,
so the #(57)PP they would spend on #(57)Evade can be used for other skills.

#c(12)- Radiant Knight Strategy -#/c
#(57)Magick Barrier lets them #c(13)negate magick attacks#/c from #c(13)Caster#/c classes.
Their "Resist Magick Assist" #c(13)leader effect#/c reduces damage from magick assists.

#c(12)- Sainted Knight Strategy -#/c
#(57)Row Barrier lets them #c(13)protect allies#/c from magick attacks,
while they can recover #(57)PP with #(56)Hache or #(56)Saint's Blade.

#c(12)- Cleric Weaknesses -#/c
Hunters are their weakness. Their low Physical Defense
makes them easy to defeat when targeted.

#c(12)- Wizard Weaknesses -#/c
They struggle against the magick negation of Radiant Knights
and Hunters, who hit the back row and act faster than them.

#c(12)- Witch Weaknesses -#/c
They struggle against the magick negation of Radiant Knights,
while their low Physical Defense leaves them vulnerable to Hunters.

#c(12)- Sorceress -#/c
When promoted, Witches become #c(13)Sorceresses#/c
capable of buffing themselves and casting magick first.

#c(12)- Shaman Strategy -#/c
#(56)Passive Curse reduces an enemy's #(57)PP and #c(13)limits their actions#/c.
This proves especially effective against #c(13)Thieves#/c and #c(13)Hoplites#/c.

#c(12)- Gryphon Knight Weaknesses -#/c
Susceptible to the arrows of #c(13)Archer#/c classes, while low Physical Defense
leaves them vulnerable to #c(13)truestrikes#/c from classes such as Swordfighters.

#c(12)- Elven Archer Weaknesses -#/c
They struggle against classes such as Fighters,
 who can negate ranged attacks with #(57)Arrow Cover.
Both physical and magick damage will be negated by this skill.

#c(12)- Werewolf Weaknesses -#/c
They struggle against the high Physical Defense
of classes like Hoplites and Fighters.

#c(12)- Werebear Weaknesses -#/c
Breakers are effective against their heavy armor.
Gryphon Masters deal damage based on their own HP.

#c(12)- Wereowl Strategy -#/c
#(57)Restore replenishes allies' #(57)PP.
This lets Berserkers use #(57)Bulk Up more times.

#c(12)- Feathersword Strategy -#/c
When the user is buffed, #(56)Honed Slash becomes a truestrike.
It is effective against scouts and flying enemies with high Evasion.

#c(12)- Priestess -#/c
The #c(13)Priestess#/c is a class unique to Scarlett.
Though fragile, it has powerful magick attacks.

#c(12)- High Priestess -#/c
The #c(13)High Priestess#/c is a class unique to Scarlett.
Its magick attacks and healing are both improved.

#c(12)- Crusader -#/c
The #c(13)Crusader#/c is a class unique to Virginia.
Despite its low Initiative, its excellent Attack and Defense support the unit.

#c(12)- Valkyria -#/c
The #c(13)Valkyria#/c is a class unique to Virginia.
It overwhelms enemies with fierce flurries of attacks.

#c(12)- Elven Augur -#/c
As an #c(13)Elven Augur#/c, Rosalinde bears excellent offensive capabilities
and can inflict both physical and magick damage with a single attack.

#c(12)- Sprites -#/c
Summoned sprites are consumed when using #c(9)Elemental Roar#/c.
Up to five sprites can be summoned at once, and skill potency
increases with the number consumed.

#c(12)- Elven Sibyl -#/c
The #c(13)Elven Sibyl#/c is a class unique to Eltolinde.
It excels at healing even more than the Elven Augur.

#c(12)- Sprites -#/c
These sprites have the same effect as those
summoned by an Elven Augur. They are used
when #c(9)Elemental Roar#/c is activated.

#c(12)- Snow Ranger -#/c
The #c(13)Snow Ranger#/c is a class unique to #c(13)Yunifi#/c.
It overwhelms armored foes with ranged attacks and powerful counters.

#c(12)- Werelion -#/c
The #c(13)Werelion#/c is a class unique to Morard.
It boasts high HP and powerful single strikes.

#c(12)- Paladin -#/c
The #c(13)Paladin#/c is a class unique to Josef.
It excels at protecting allies.

#c(12)- Prince -#/c
The #c(13)Prince#/c is a class unique to Gilbert.
It excels at raising allies' morale and supporting them.

#c(12)- Dreadnought -#/c
The #c(13)Dreadnought#/c is a class unique to Amalia.
Its overwhelming strength can negate enemy guards.

#c(12)- Dark Marquess (Sword) -#/c
The #c(13)Dark Marquess (Sword)#/c is a class unique to Nigel.
It inflicts Burn and finishes off enemies near death.

#c(12)- Dark Marquess (Lance) -#/c
The #c(13)Dark Marquess (Lance)#/c is a class unique to Elgor.
Its high Evasion lets it toy with enemies.

#c(12)- Dark Marquess (Axe) -#/c
The #c(13)Dark Marquess (Axe)#/c is a class unique to Berengaria.
It overwhelms enemies with fierce flurries of attacks.

#c(12)- Dark Marquess (Staff) -#/c
The #c(13)Dark Marquess (Staff)#/c is a class unique to Alcina.
Its high Magick Attack and afflictions let it finish enemies reliably.

#c(12)- Necromancer -#/c
The #c(13)Necromancer#/c is a class unique to Baltro.
It brings fallen allies back to fight again.

#c(12)- Dark Lord -#/c
The #c(13)Dark Lord#/c is a class unique to Galerius.
Its immense power brings enemies to the brink of death.

#c(12)- Overlord -#/c
The #c(13)Overlord#/c is a class unique to Galerius.
It overwhelms enemies with the power of a king.

#c(12)- Heraldry -#/c
From the overworld menu, select Heraldry to edit a character's
emblem. Completing quests earns new emblem designs.

#c(12)- Class Registry -#/c
View animations for the classes you have recruited.
You can also view their backgrounds.

Liberation sets out to ask why he serves the very
enemy that destroyed his band.

In Cornia's swamplands, Alain learns by chance
that Zenoiran soldiers intend to capture all the
witches living in the region.


The village on the border of Cornia and Elheim,
also known as the Witches' Village, has fallen
under Zenoiran control. At Yahna's request, the
Liberation sets out to free it.

The Knights' Domain was granted autonomy
under Cornian rule, but is now held by the Zenoiran
general Gaston. Joined by Adel, a knight who
refused to serve him and left, the Liberation sets out
to reclaim the domain.

After the Zenoiran knight Renault takes Scarlett
captive in a surprise attack, the Liberation sets out
to capture Renault's stronghold, #FN(C5北の町), and
rescue Scarlett.

When the Black Talon Bandits strike Rondmort Church
in southwestern Cornia, the Liberation joins forces
with Ochlys, a Heavenswing Knight
of the Palevian Orthodoxy, to reclaim the church
from the bandits.

In Cornia's La Criselle region, the Rock Rats
have taken over a fort and repeatedly raid the towns.
Defeat them and restore peace to La Criselle
and Tiche Donné.

Black Talon Bandits have raided #FN(C10西の町).
According to people who fled the town, members of
the Cornian militia came to their rescue. The
Liberation joins forces with them to free the town.

Melisandre, a general from a distinguished former
Cornian noble family, is said to oversee a Zenoiran
supply depot. Defeat her and liberate the region.

Traveling through the Saint le Riche region, Alain
and his companions try to rescue Hans from bandits,
but Monica, a knight commanding the local forces,
reaches him first. Hans has something to tell them.


Hans asks Monica to rescue his companions,
who have been abducted by bandits. Unable to
move her troops for now, Monica asks Alain and
his companions to undertake the rescue instead.


Alain and his companions rescue Hans's group,
but Monica has recognized Alain's true identity.
She explains that, as her territorial forces serve
under Zenoira, they must fight the Liberation.


Once a Cornian noble, Monica now governs her
lands as a Zenoiran general. Having encountered
the Liberation, she cannot simply let them pass
and makes it clear that she intends to fight.

A mysterious epidemic has struck the Chouvre
region. The sick are forcibly confined to the lord's
manor, and none have come out alive. Defeat the
lord and free his subjects from fear.

The Zenoiran sorcerer Auch is investigating the
ruins in Cornia's Veille region and forbids anyone
from approaching them.


Auch and his Zenoiran troops occupy the ruins in
Cornia's Veille region. The Liberation sets out to
defeat him and free the area from Zenoiran
control.

Having secured a route into Drakenhold, the
Liberation hears that Prince Gilbert is gathering
soldiers and hopes to request their help. They
cross the liberated checkpoint into Drakenhold.


A Zenoiran general is to be executed in a mining
town on the border between Cornia and Drakenhold.
Despite tight security, the Liberation aims to free
the town and eliminate this threat behind them.

Drakenhold's desert, once used as a place of exile,
is dangerous land—and Aubin's childhood home.
Worried about the people he knows there, Aubin asks
to stop by and offers to guide the Liberation.

Prince Gilbert of Drakenhold also lost his kingdom
to Galerius. Now gathering troops in Baumratte,
he is said to be awaiting Alain's arrival.


Gilbert, Drakenhold's second prince, raised troops
to restore his kingdom and recaptured Baumratte.
But Zenoira has returned with a great army. Alain
joins Gilbert in defending the
city.

#FN(D4北東の港町), in Drakenhold's Früth region, is a

Through Leah's arrangements, the Liberation joins
forces with the Früth Militia to take the port.

Gilbert is assembling troops to
retake #FN(D5城). He hopes to fight alongside the
Liberation again and asks to meet them at
#FN(D5東の砦).


Gilbert's troops have gathered at #FN(D5東の砦)

him there to fight the Zenoiran army occupying
Drakenhold.

The enemy general Giethe holds #FN(D6要塞).

Virginia and the Knights of the Rose for ten years.
The Liberation marches to capture his fortress.

Learning that a Zenoiran army led by
Gloucester, the Black Knight of Drakenhold, is

more information on their newfound foe.


Suspecting Gloucester is under
the magick of control, the Liberation
marches into the desert to bring him
back to his senses.

Ömpalast region, due largely to its bountiful veins

Liberation sets forth to see the area freed.

Lhinalagos has used Elheim's terrain to help his
resistance fighters withstand Zenoira's attacks.
But relentless pursuit has left them nowhere to run.
The Cornian Liberation Army marches to their rescue.

Símtukka is a human town on Elheim's outskirts.
For reasons unknown, Zenoira has sealed off this
ordinary town. Ask its inhabitants what happened.


Zenoira has blockaded #FN(E2中央の町) because
surviving Elheim soldiers are hiding inside.
Even residents cannot enter their homes.
The Liberation marches to lift the blockade.


Elina, the mayor's daughter,
sheltered Ithilion, a
leader of the surviving Elheim resistance. Fearing
trouble for the town, he left on his own. The
Liberation sets out to save him.

Laurhal, Elheim's verdant capital, is under
Zenoiran rule. Within its captured castle is
Eltolinde, the priestess and Rosalinde's younger
sister. First, reach the outskirts of Laurhal.


Laurhal, Elheim's verdant capital, is under
Zenoiran rule. Within its captured castle is
Eltolinde, the priestess and Rosalinde's younger
sister. Retake Castle Laurhal and rescue her.

Eltolinde says they are heading toward the Divine
Tree, a symbol of the elves. Fearing the worst,
the Liberation gives chase.

the Ring of the Unicorn are kept in the library of
the Tower of Thorns, now occupied by Zenoira.
Alain sets out for the tower.

the Liberation finds no sign of elves—or even
Zenoiran soldiers—near the Forest of Thorns.
Uneasy, the army enters the forest.

Alcina leaves, saying they will settle matters at
the Tower of Thorns, where the ancient texts are
kept. Deep within the Forest of Thorns, the tower
is also Zenoira's base of operations in Elheim.

Defeat the general and liberate the region.

subordinates, and Alain's army goes to help.

said to have hidden it in Blizzard Village.


An area battered by ceaseless
snowstorms.

Zenoiran forces nearby, the Liberation heads into

Hearing that Zenoiran soldiers are marching

Raenys's comrades.


Albion, too, has anti-Zenoiran resistance fighters.
Raenys's comrades are hiding in a church, but

The Liberation marches out to save them.

gate leading there.


The gate is locked, but Scarlett unexpectedly

At the garden, Umerus suddenly draws her sword

disarms her when her guard drops, but she flees.
Sensing danger, he prepares for battle

With a route to Gran Corrine secured, the
Liberation has one objective left: defeat Galerius,
Emperor of Zenoira. Alain, crown prince of Cornia,
prepares for the final battle.

the continent; its ruins now stretch across
northwestern Cornia. Summoned by a sage from the
Zenoiran sanctuary southeast of the ruins, Alain heads there.


Scars of the calamity left in ancient Zenoira's ruins

is now on the verge of revival. The Liberation faces
its final trial to free the ancient city of calamity,

I've cleared it with the lord who hired me. Looking forward to working with you.
I didn't expect you to turn down my offer to join after all that...
Oh, and the quarry southeast of here is now open for use.
You might find some valuable ore there. Drop by if you like.
It seems he's prepared to rebel against Zenoira and fight alongside you.
He can't openly mobilize his knights.

Sorry for stopping you.
I can't talk about this out loud, but...
I lead the mercenary band hired by the lord here.
Where to begin...? The lord here is a gentle man.
When Zenoira invaded, he couldn't bear to see his people and retainers shed blood...

So he submitted to Zenoira without resistance,
on the condition that no blood be shed.
But Zenoira's outrageous demands have grown worse by the day...
But even he seems to have reached the limit of what he can tolerate.
If you Liberation Army folks are really as strong as the rumors say...
It's not a bad deal, is it? Show me what you can do.
I'm counting on the Liberation Army. Give it your best.
Look! So many windmills have been built thanks to you!
Now maybe we'll get to eat delicious bread every day!
I'm picking flowers for Berenice-oneechan.
It's to thank her for playing with us so much at the orphanage!
I had an awful time the other day. Enemies suddenly appeared and surrounded me...
I barely escaped with my life. Maybe I should quit being a mercenary and take up mining.
Life has only grown harder since Galerius-sama took power.
I hope the Liberation Army can turn things around...

Feels like it was only yesterday I heard rumors of a rebel army,
and now you've already made it this far!
Of course I'm rooting for you! Oh, I should call you the Cornian Liberation Army now.
Berenice-sama is hard to read, but she never forgets a kindness.
I hear she even donated the reward she received from the lord to the orphanage that took care of her.
I want to know if it's true. If you find one, let me know.
Mumble, mumble... There are treasure maps buried here...
If I go where the map points... I'll find treasure and be rich...
You folks... Got enough money to hire a miner?
I've heard you can sometimes find treasure maps while mining.
Ask them to dig and obtain a treasure map.
...Wait, you already have a map? Let me see! Let me see!
So this is a treasure map... They really do exist.
Thanks for showing me. Someday I'll dig one up myself...
Your Highness, I'll be going now.
Please take good care of my older sister.
Thanks, Millé. This time, I'll fight my own battle.
Take care, Nee-san. I'll look after the house and wait for you.
Once again, I'm Nina. I look forward to working with you.
My family is prestigious and wealthy, so earning my knighthood should be easy.
Ah, members of the Liberation Army. Sorry to ask so suddenly, but I have a request.

They're using #FN(C9南東の砦)
as a base of operations to raid our village.

Could the Liberation Army
drive those bandits off for us?
Bandits... We can't simply leave them be. All right, leave it to us.
Thank you! There aren't very many of them.
But I've heard there's one very skilled woman among them. Please don't let your guard down.

Excuse me... I overheard you.
Is it true you're with the Liberation Army?
I'm Alain, leader of the Liberation Army.
The crown prince himself?! Forgive my rudeness.
My name is Millé, and I'm a knight. There's something I'd like to ask...
If you're going after those bandits, please let me come with you.
Someone I'm looking for might be among those bandits...
All right. You're welcome to come with us.
But we're heading into battle. You'll have to follow our orders.
Thank you. I'll bring my men when it's time to deploy.
I wish the Liberation Army good fortune on the road ahead.

I've got plenty of work again thanks to you.
I owe my livelihood to the Liberation Army!
To be honest, I feel a little lonely now that the Rock Rats are gone.
We hit it off at the tavern. They were good people.
All we can do is pray to the Unicorn, the symbol of the Palevian Orthodoxy.
Please protect our town from calamity...
Alain-sama, thank you for your support!
I've left my hometown to find work, but...

No matter how far away they are,
family is still what keeps you going.
One day I'll take over the family estate—and become a knight, too.

Me?
Of course they passed me right by.
The Rock Rats bought bread from me, you know. At full price, too.

Thank you, Your Highness.
I can finally return home now.

This Walled City of Barbatimo belongs to Mordon-sama,
leader of the Iron Helm Mercenaries.
If you value your life, stay away.
We've liberated #FN(GK_C04関所). You can now pass through safely.
Rebels...? We can't let you through here!
We've liberated #FN(GK_C06関所). You can now pass through safely.
Damn rebels... I won't let you go any farther!

The Walled City of Barbatimo is
occupied by Mordon.

If we want to go any farther,
we'll have to defeat the enemy occupying the city.

We should wait until we're properly prepared
before challenging them.
Town rebuilding, bridge repairs—you name it. I'm your man.
They were delighted that the inn could reopen.
It's thanks to the Liberation Army. Thank you.
Thanks to you, things are starting to liven up again!
We rebuilt thanks to the Liberation Army. Thank you.
I'm glad the inn reopened. The food's so good I could eat there again and again!
Ugh... I drank too much. We had a feast at the inn with the rest of my unit.
On my father's honor, I won't let you take this town!
Everyone in town is talking about you.
Stories like that become #c(18)Renown#/c and spread across the land.
We've sold out of ripe honey apples. Thank you!
I've only got three ripe honey apples left. Would you like to buy them for 600 gold?
Looks like you don't have enough money. I'll be here if you want to try again.
If you change your mind, just let me know.
How's Mordon-san getting along in the Liberation Army?
The rebel army, now? What terrible timing... Gather the troops in training at the fort!

So you're the rebels?
Thanks for liberating the fort.
Mercenaries have been gathering here looking for work.
They call me Mardie the Indomitable. I'll never yield to you!
Thank you for liberating our town.
Sorry we keep having to rely on you. Everyone in town is grateful.
Security at the checkpoints has gotten tighter, probably because the Liberation Army has been so active lately.
I saw how the Liberation Army fights. Not bad at all!
Sorry we keep having to rely on you. Everyone in town is grateful.
So you're the rebels causing trouble all over the place!
Thank you for liberating our town.
Leave this town's security to us, the local watch.
To think you'd help a town that was on the verge of ruin...
Thank you so much. You've been a great help...

Head northeast from here,
and you'll reach the old Bastorias border.
There are quite a few bestrals there, so you'd better be careful.
I've heard a plague broke out south of this town and killed a great many people.
To think you'd help a town that was on the verge of ruin...
Thank you so much. You've been a great help...
What, you're here already...!? You won't use this harbor! Burn it! Burn it down!
Thank you for liberating our town.
I had no idea a prince was leading the Liberation Army... My apologies.
Thank you for bringing aid even to a remote place like this.
Apparently, this harbor was used to transport enslaved bestrals until a few years ago.
The right to rule comes from bloodline. Cornia rightfully belongs to you, Alain-sama.

Please accept my apology on my father's behalf
for believing Galerius's lies.
The rebels are here? Good thing I hired those bandits.
Those bandits were giving us a terrible time. The Liberation Army really came through for us!
Thanks for fixing my roof! The leaks were awful...

You'll find a patch of ruins to the northwest of here.
Some kind of magic circle, I think?
There was a shaman there, holding her head and looking troubled.
Bastorias lies to the north, and many bestrals live there.
But after losing the war, most of them were apparently enslaved by the Zenoiran Army.
We cannot surrender this place. Prepare for the rebel army's attack!

The Black Talons have Zenoira backing them,
so they're a formidable armed group.
You actually drove them off? That's the Liberation Army for you...
If you're coming for us, we have no choice... Everyone, prepare for battle!
You pay pretty well... Why not hire the folks at the fort, too?
I saw you liberate the fort. Thanks for that.
The rebels, here? And we only just managed to secure this base through negotiations with Zenoira...
Watch out for the regular Zenoiran troops patrolling the area as you go.
Foolish rebels... You dare set foot in the town I protect?
Oh... So you're the ones who liberated the town.

If you can, we'd appreciate some deliveries
to help repair the town.
The small ember Ilenia-sama left behind has now become a light of hope in this land...
The old Zenoiran ruins to the north of town are dangerous. There are plenty of bandits, too.

...But you don't look like the type to listen
even if I tried to stop you.
The miners are back and the town's lively again. Thank you!
Not long ago, this town was bustling with miners...
With a few deliveries, we can keep repairing the town and maybe reopen the quarry...
I haven't gathered much stone yet. Come back the day after tomorrow.
I've gathered quite a lot of stone. Come back tomorrow.
I've got about twenty blocks of stone left over from the repairs. Want them for 2,000 gold?
Looks like you don't have enough money. Come back when you've got more to spend.

If you change your mind,
just let me know.
I swear on my honor that I'll protect this town!
The Liberation Army has finally come to our town! We've been waiting for you...
You'll find a patch of ruins just over there. Some kind of magic circle, by the looks of it.
There's a woman there who spends all day groaning over something.
Not sure what to do about her...

With the river here, this town once prospered
as a waypoint on the road to the capital.
Now our trade with other places has been cut off, and the town's in terrible shape...
I can't say it too loudly, but I'm rooting for you.
You've come a long way, Alain-sama! Go on—the royal castle is right ahead!
Oh, so you've had a feast too! See? It gets everyone talking, doesn't it?

When everyone drinks and eats together,
you get talking even with people you normally don't.
...Wait, you've already held a feast at the inn? No wonder you're leading an army!
Eat at an inn in a fortified city or castle.

If you're leading troops,
why not hold a feast at the inn?
No use losing our nerve. We'll hit them with everything we've got!
Hey, what's the rebel army doing all the way out here?
This fort is a base for investigating the ancient Zenoiran ruins. Are you rebels after the treasures there?
Thanks to you, the quarry's open again. What a relief!

Alain, beyond this point lies the former
Kingdom of Drakenhold.
It's all under the Zenoiran Army's control now, though...
You folks come from somewhere else?
Then you'd better be careful up ahead.
Did something happen?

The Zenoiran soldiers are guarding the area
more heavily than usual.
Apparently, someone is due to be executed soon.
I saw them taking a prisoner away.

Berengaria!?
Oh, no... Sorry. It's nothing...
Alain... Either way,
We should liberate this region so we don't leave a threat at our backs.

Are you ready?

Drakenhold and Cornia.
Thank you for helping restore the checkpoint.
We'll cooperate with the Liberation Army against our common enemy, Zenoira.
If we're fighting Zenoira, I'll give it everything I've got.
My name is Aramis. I'll fight as a mercenary for the Liberation Army.
Alain-sama, this man says he'd like to join the Liberation Army too...

W-well... I just got carried away trying to prove I can still keep up with the young ones...
And yet you've done so much to help us...
Thank you. We'll do our best to make a life for ourselves, too.

to protect my family.
I'll work hard so I can become strong like you someday.

We were just discussing what we can do
to defend ourselves.
The threat to the town is gone, but there's no guarantee it won't happen again...
Dad's really good at arm wrestling, so I know he's strong!
They worked me to the bone at the quarry. I've had enough hard labor...
Maybe I should enter the coliseum and try to strike it rich...
Don't bother. Swinging a pickaxe is the only thing you know how to do.
Such generous aid... As the leader of this town, let me thank you.
This should make life a little easier for everyone in town.
We'll work with everyone in town and do our best to carry on.
I see... In that case, I'd be happy to oblige.
This is my hometown. I'll show you around.
Thanks for your help... I'll make it up to you, I swear.

Looks like those bandits changed their ways after you beat them.
My younger brother works as a town guard. He's timid but diligent, so I worry about him.
As long as we can live in peace, we don't care who's in charge—even Zenoira.
No, no. I can't stand this heat anymore!
I came looking for Zenoiran relics, but the sandstorms make searching a real ordeal.
We've still got plenty of food and water. Let's keep trying a little longer.

Thanks for the deliveries.
You've made the town easier to live in.
You lot work even harder than we do! Gahaha!

Escorting, hauling, rough jobs—we'll take anything. Some of the lads would love to work for you.

It's full of ruffians and shady types.

Baumratte, home to the coliseum, is the largest city in Drakenhold.

Then I think I'll have a look around town.
Hehe... Take your time and rest.
You can't go any farther without Gilbert-sama's permission.
You cannot pass this point without Gilbert-sama's permission.

We'll be waiting for the Liberation Army's help.

Um... I may look like this, but I'm actually a coward...
The coliseum isn't a fight to the death. They're only mock battles.
But I still can't watch without worrying someone might get hurt.
Though a mercenary like you probably has no use for them... Hic!

That woman, Amalia, became the coliseum champion
in no time.
She's incredible... No one can beat her.
The war with the Zenoiran Army is still going on, yet people keep coming to the coliseum...
People have all sorts of opinions about the coliseum, both for and against it...
But I think it's good that people of lower standing have a chance to rise in the world.

Hear they'll let just about anyone join the Liberation Army.
Maybe I should give it a shot, myself.

I hear mercenaries are getting less work now,
with the Zenoiran Army building up its regular forces.
I was terrified when the Zenoiran Army marched through here on its way to Baumratte...
Hot springs are common to the east, but... the geysers are dangerous.
A direct hit could seriously injure you... Be careful.
But how did Zenoira manage to invade this place?
Zenoira took control around here without any fighting...
Thank you sincerely for all your help.
It's basically a back way in.
What's wrong, Travis? Why are you in such a hurry?
My older sister... Baltro took her away...
Damn it...! It's all because I let my guard down...
...I don't know what he's after, but if he took her for a reason...
Berengaria must still be safe. For now, let's believe that and keep going.
All right... Please help me save my older sister...!
I do love swords, so I quit being a mercenary and thought I'd make a living in the coliseum...
But I'm too scared... Um, could you try fighting in the coliseum for me...?
I'm hardly one to talk, but... I hear a woman named Amalia is incredibly strong.

I'll master swordsmanship well enough to slice through an opponent's flesh...

I'll take my leave, then.

At any rate, we have an agreement. As long as we can fight together, it should be fine.
We've occupied this fort, but it isn't within our territory, so there are no mercenaries here...
To defeat an enemy force that large... I'm in awe of you, Alain-sama.
So the Liberation Army isn't fighting just for Cornia.
A splendid victory, Your Highness! Securing this land is a major gain!
Be careful when you march through the area.
The surviving members of the Früth Militia will stay in town and help govern it.
It means a great deal that Your Highness came to the militia's aid.
The Früth Militia is hiding somewhere around here.

This garrison belongs to the Zenoiran Army.
Stay away.

This port is under the Zenoiran Empire's rule.
Get lost.
I hear the Cornian Liberation Army spent a long time steadily preparing its uprising.
We should have followed their example.
We have the Zenoiran Army as a common enemy. I'm ready to set our petty grudges aside.

I hear the leader of the Liberation Army

I can't believe Zenoira's long rule ended so easily...
Thank you, all of you.
We have to keep moving forward, one step at a time.
The Zenoiran Army controls this area. Get lost.
Thank you again, Your Highness. Leave the town's security to us.

I guess that's all resolve made in the heat of the moment is worth.

The town's still a mess, but at least we're free

That's why the Zenoirans
were so on edge.

The ones who sucked up to the Zenoiran Army

Mister, did you fix our house?
Daddy said that since the scary people are gone now...
I can go play outside! So I'm going to play with all my friends!
So you managed to reclaim Drakenhold? It must have been hard on Gilbert-sama, too.

I thought about going back to town,
but the desert's not so bad.
Maybe I'll settle here for good.
I got caught in a sandstorm and thought I was going to die...
Then a long-haired swordsman appeared out of nowhere and led me here.
I can't thank him enough.
I'm glad Prince Gilbert is back.
What am I doing out here? I was freed not long ago.
He defeated soldiers bigger than himself with such graceful swordsmanship. I was amazed.
With moves like that, he must be someone famous.
Some grown-ups came to pick me up.
I'm not alone anymore, thanks to that blond-haired boy.
A long-haired boy came and told me to hide here.
He was so cool... I hope I get to see him again.
Thank you, Prince Alain.

The prince is incredible.
He must have been through so much.
I can't let him outdo me. I've got to protect everyone in town.
We've been hearing a lot about the prince lately.
There isn't much here now, but someday I'll turn it into a thriving town.
And then perhaps Gilbert-sama will... Hehehe...
I hear Gilbert-sama has returned.
Things may be hard now, but the prince will surely come to our aid...
I believe he'll lead Drakenhold.
He overcame so much and still managed to reclaim the kingdom.
I hear Prince Gilbert has returned.
Apparently, he managed to escape when the castle fell.
We're counting on the prince. I know he'll take our country back.
Thank you for the Liberation Army's help. Let's fight together.
I never got to meet the prince in the end...
But if he's king now, he must be in the capital.
I'll make a name for myself and earn an audience with him somehow.
I would've liked to meet Prince Gilbert too.

Hear he's been goin' around here
savin' people.
We'll take care of things while the king is away.
We'll all support the king and devote ourselves to rebuilding.
Alain, I've been waiting for you.
From now on, I'm a member of the Liberation Army too. I look forward to serving under your command.
I've heard everything. Please take good care of His Majesty.
Alain, let's defeat Galerius and bring down Zenoira together.
The people of Drakenhold will support His Majesty and devote themselves to rebuilding.
Prince Gilbert has raised Drakenhold's flag over the royal castle once more.
I'm done working as a mercenary. I'm going back to the church.
Damn, I missed my chance to earn anything in that battle. Nothing but wyvern knights to fight...
We managed to repair the damaged houses. Now the real work begins.
The townspeople have repaired their homes and are already getting back to their old lives.
People really are resilient, aren't they?
A lady with long hair rescued me from those scary soldiers!
She swung a thin sword around so fast! She was really strong!

I was swinging my sword to prepare for the coming battle,
and ended up hurting my lower back...
My husband's gotten strangely fired up. If I don't keep an eye on him, he'll head straight for the battlefield.

Thanks to your help,
rebuilding should go quickly.
I should make sure this statue is polished, too.
At least I survived. If I get a reward on top of that, I've got nothing to complain about.
That was some battle. We couldn't have won without the Liberation Army.
The knightly orders and military units need reorganizing, but we don't even know whether the rear command staff survived.
For now, I just want to take off this damn heavy armor and sleep without thinking about anything.
We took heavy losses, but we should be glad we've got our homeland back.
That was my first time commanding a unit... I'm glad everyone survived.
Drakenhold is in a terrible state right now.

But things should work out.
The prince is back, after all.
Glory to Drakenhold!
I'm especially curious about Elheim. I'd love to meet an elf...

The Drakenhold army has no forces to spare.
Right now, all we can do is defend our own country.

Looks like this country can finally start rebuilding.
Maybe I'll head home for a while...
This impregnable fortress was built back when Cornia and Drakenhold were at war.
I hear it's called Fort Pritzlasse.
This is my first time seeing the fortress from this side...
Leave the scouting to me. I'll reconnoiter from the air.
I'm counting on you.
Good work. Tell us what you've learned.
There are a lot of strategic points to capture... We'd better advance carefully.
Prince Gilbert has gathered his forces at Castle Soldraga, leaving only a few sentries here.
Your Highness! You've reclaimed the castle!
Let's retake the fortress ahead of us, too!

a fortress in neighboring Drakenhold.

Cornia and Drakenhold
were once at war.

Leave the defense here to us.
We won't let the Zenoiran Army through.
I hear Princess Virginia was the one who defeated the enemy commander in this fortress...
She lives up to her reputation as a formidable warrior! We all admire her.
I've heard a rumor about Fort Pritzlasse...
The commander in charge is skilled, but even his own side considers him infamous.
The general who commanded the fortress was notorious for killing prisoners of war.
I hear even some Zenoiran soldiers are glad he's dead.
Thanks to you, the town is lively again.
I'll protect this place so no one has to grieve again.
Now that the town is lively again, it's our time to shine!
Ah, thank you. We don't have to live in fear anymore...
So you've retaken the capital.
Thank you, youngsters. It's all thanks to you.

I was knocked unconscious by an enemy catapult.
I woke up behind a rock. My comrades must have carried me there.
All my comrades died defending this place.
Quack, quack!
People cry out for revenge and resentment, but in the end, it's all empty.
I heard the lady next door once apprenticed under a distinguished teacher in Cornia.
Oh, so the capital's been retaken. What a relief...
Thank you, everyone. I'll never forget what you've done for us.

more soldiers will just keep coming...
Mining isn't easy, but I've got to do my best for the town.
Excellent work retaking Fort Pritzlasse!
Leave the postwar work to us. We'll keep the people safe.

We're counting on you Liberation Army folks to do your part, too.

I'll do everything I can to help you rebuild the kingdom.

Alain-dono...
From now on, I'll protect this desert in Magellan-dono's place.

An enemy...!?

Magellan! You're only making things worse!
