prayed that peace would endure.

The island's children especially loved her
frequent talks about the comrades she had
known in the Liberation Army.

#s(0.95)#c(12)Fodoquia
#s(0.75)￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣#/c#s(0.85)
After completing his duties with the
Liberation Army, Fodoquia returned to his
lands and worked to rebuild them.

Rather than turn away from the rift between
himself and his people, he faced each
responsibility with care, one step at a
time. Gradually he won their hearts, and
they reconciled.

From then on, flowers were never absent from
his beloved son's grave.

#s(0.95)#c(12)Jerome
#s(0.75)￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣#/c#s(0.85)
After returning to his lands, now free of
Zenoira, Jerome set about rebuilding his
town alongside its people.

Though he lacked the charisma of a great
leader, he trusted and relied on his people
and sometimes treated them to sweets. They
affectionately nicknamed him 'Lord of
Sweets.'

#s(0.95)#c(12)Sanatio
#s(0.75)￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣#/c#s(0.85)
Sanatio traveled from place to place,
helping with reconstruction and encountering
many different forms of faith that renewed
his outlook.

Scarlett and other priests nominated him as
the next pontiff. He refused time and again,
but eventually answered the wishes of the
faithful and accepted the office.

From then on, he worked alongside Nigel and
others to guide the Orthodoxy, devoting the
rest of his life to its followers.

#s(0.95)#c(12)Yunifi
#s(0.75)￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣#/c#s(0.85)
Stories spread beyond the borders of
Bastorias about the brave girl raised by
bestrals who had fought for her country.
Soon, many tales were written about Yunifi.

Those stories helped people who had never
seen a bestral think of them as a familiar
people. Yunifi in particular became a hero
admired by children throughout Fevrith.

#s(0.95)#c(12)Ramona
#s(0.75)￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣#/c#s(0.85)
Even after Zenoira's defeat, Ramona
continued to lead the Frostblooms,
protecting wounded bestrals and spearheading
the rebuilding of their country and
villages. She became known as the Farseeing
Sage.

She supported the new king's rule and
devoted her life to the prosperity of
Bastorias and its ties with other nations.

#s(0.95)#c(12)Morard
#s(0.75)￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣#/c#s(0.85)
As one of the surviving lion bestrals,
Morard was urged by many people of Bastorias
to become their king, and decided to accept
the throne.

Knowing life as both a human and a bestral,
he respected both equally and won the
support of every race. He became a true
Lion King, in both name and deed.

#s(0.95)#c(12)Govil
#s(0.75)￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣#/c#s(0.85)
The new king appointed Govil captain of the
knights, but Govil entrusted the post to a
subordinate he trusted and took over his
grandfather's tavern instead.

The place was old but full of warmth, and
for many years it thrived as a gathering
place where bestrals could relax.

#s(0.95)#c(12)Bertrand
#s(0.75)￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣#/c#s(0.85)
After the war, Bertrand helped rebuild the
villages. Once that work was done, he raised
memorials across Bastorias for every soul
lost in the fighting.

Every year on the anniversary of the war's
end, people laid bouquets at the memorials,
and their fragrance was said to fill the
whole country.

#s(0.95)#c(12)Dinah
#s(0.75)￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣#/c#s(0.85)
At a comrade's suggestion, Dinah led
the Whiteflower Squad in rebuilding
villages across the land.

Her loyalty to her companions and gift for
leadership proved just as valuable off the
battlefield. People seeking to join her unit
came in droves, both humans and bestrals.

Over time, her distrust of humans gradually
softened.

#s(0.95)#c(12)Bryce
#s(0.75)￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣#/c#s(0.85)
Bryce and the men who had served with him in
his bandit gang became mercenaries, helping
with postwar relief and reconstruction in
towns across the land.

He was quick to take on the jobs no one else
wanted. Warmhearted and always working
behind the scenes, he became well liked by
his comrades and townsfolk alike.

#s(0.95)#c(12)Nina
#s(0.75)￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣#/c#s(0.85)
After the war, Nina returned home. Her
younger sister was overjoyed, and her
parents were relieved to see their daughter
safe.

Once she had reconciled with her family, she
set off again to help people around the
world with her companions.

She became famous as the highborn tomboy
knight, and people asked to shake her hand
wherever she went.

#s(0.95)#c(12)Hodrick
#s(0.75)￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣#/c#s(0.85)
After the war, Hodrick became captain of the
new Cornian king's royal guard. He looked
after every soldier, training alongside them
until they became a force of exceptional
skill and unity.

He often sparred with his mentor Josef, and
crowds of soldiers would flock to the
training grounds to watch the two masters
face off.

#s(0.95)#c(12)Josef
#s(0.75)￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣#/c#s(0.85)
For protecting the prince and laying the
foundations of the Liberation Army, Josef
was offered the office of chancellor. He
declined and spent his life as a knight,
serving as the king's sword.

As stern a mentor as ever, he trained the
knights in both body and mind, building a
formidable defense for the new Cornia.

#s(0.95)#c(12)Renault
#s(0.75)￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣#/c#s(0.85)
Renault chose to return to the town where,
once controlled by Zenoira, he had ruled as
a lord and made the people suffer.

Some could not forgive him, but many came to
support him when they saw how sincerely he
accepted both the disgrace and the criticism
he had earned.

Determined to start again alongside his
people, he became a good leader who looked
toward the future rather than the past.

#s(0.95)#c(12)Clive
#s(0.75)￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣#/c#s(0.85)
Clive left the new Cornian king's royal
guard and returned to the
Knights' Domain, where he and his comrades sought
a new path to self-government.

His belief in solidarity over authority
spread not only among the other knights but
also among the farmers, reviving the
territory's founding spirit.

#s(0.95)#c(12)Adel
#s(0.75)￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣#/c#s(0.85)
When Adel returned to the Knights' Domain
after the war, knights and commoners alike
greeted him with congratulations.

Cheerful and easygoing, he was everyone's
favorite. When he went into town on patrol,
children dragged him away to play during the
day, and at night he drank with the locals
until he passed out.

He remained the territory's most beloved and
well-known knight.

#s(0.95)#c(12)Berenice
#s(0.75)￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣#/c#s(0.85)
When the Liberation Army disbanded, Berenice
spent time honing her skills while helping
rebuild Cornia and hunting bandits.

Several years later, she returned to the
Knights' Domain, her swordsmanship
sharper than ever, and the knights welcomed
her back.

She devoted herself to training the next
generation, helping raise the strength of
the entire order.

#s(0.95)#c(12)Rolf
#s(0.75)￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣#/c#s(0.85)
After his work with the Liberation Army
ended, Rolf's skill earned him a post as a
forest warden.

He protected villages from dangerous beasts
and poachers, and helped bring their ravaged
forests back to life through careful
tending.

People praised him as a proud guardian of
the woods.

#s(0.95)#c(12)Mordon
#s(0.75)￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣#/c#s(0.85)
After the war, Mordon gave up mercenary work
and returned to his trade as a stonemason.

At first he concentrated on rebuilding the
town. Once it flourished again, he turned
his eye for beauty to creating buildings
with elaborate designs.

Mordon Street, lined with his work, drew a
steady stream of visitors who came to admire
its architecture, and remained beloved for
generations.

#s(0.95)#c(12)Auch
#s(0.75)￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣#/c#s(0.85)
After telling his mother at her grave what
he had accomplished with the Liberation
Army, Auch never returned to his childhood
home. Instead, he threw himself into magical
research, following his own passions.

The books he later wrote became valuable
guides for aspiring mages without any
special background or upbringing.

#s(0.95)#c(12)Jeremy
#s(0.75)￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣#/c#s(0.85)
After the war, Jeremy quietly disappeared
from the Liberation Army and returned to his
carefree life as a wandering mercenary.

Even in dangerous situations, his tricks and
quick thinking got him out alive, and he
lived a long life.

Mercenaries still tell the story of the
night he and his old comrades from the war
drank away an enormous battle reward in a
single evening.

#s(0.95)#c(12)Miriam
#s(0.75)￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣#/c#s(0.85)
After Cornia's restoration, Miriam was
appointed captain of the Knights of the
Rose.

Her dignified bearing and proven skill made
her a role model for female knights both at
home and abroad.

She devoted herself to training younger
knights and fostering unity. Every member of
the force she commanded, down to the lowest
ranks, was said to work together in perfect
harmony.

#s(0.95)#c(12)Kitra
#s(0.75)￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣#/c#s(0.85)
After the war, Kitra served with the Knights
of the Rose and helped keep the castle town
safe.

Whenever troublemakers appeared, she was
first on the scene, often putting on quite a
fight to the cheers of the townspeople.

Her skill with her hands also proved useful
in repairing the town. The children were
especially fond of her.

#s(0.95)#c(12)Fran
#s(0.75)￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣#/c#s(0.85)
In recognition of her service during the
war, Fran was offered the post of deputy
captain of the Knights of the Rose, but
politely declined.

She wanted to stand beside her companions,
not above them, so she could be the first to
help whenever they were in danger.

Her friends smiled at the answer, which was
just what they expected from someone who
worried about them so much.

#s(0.95)#c(12)Melisandre
#s(0.75)￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣#/c#s(0.85)
Once peace returned to Cornia, Melisandre
slipped past her own adjutant and visited
the royal palace each day to propose
marriage to the king.

Her wish never came true, but the sword
dances she performed at royal banquets
became renowned for their beauty and power,
captivating many a guest.

#s(0.95)#c(12)Colm
#s(0.75)￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣#/c#s(0.85)
After the war, House Meillet began rebuilding,
and Colm was even happier about it than
Melisandre, the head of the house herself.

Keeping up with his fickle mistress had always
been difficult, but once the man she had set
her heart on became king, Colm's worries only
seemed to multiply.

#s(0.95)#c(12)Monica
#s(0.75)￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣#/c#s(0.85)
In recognition of Monica's service with the
Liberation Army, House Nordheim regained its
former standing.

Her integrity and tireless dedication won
the support of her people. Even after the
death of her beloved grandfather, she proved
herself an able ruler of their lands.

Despite her many duties, she always made
time to hold stargazing gatherings with her
retainers and thank them for their hard
work.

#s(0.95)#c(12)Colm
#s(0.75)￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣#/c#s(0.85)
After the war, House Meillet began its
recovery.

Colm was as delighted as if Melisandre's
wish had been his own. Yet taking charge of
the noble house in her place left him with
mixed feelings.

His unwavering loyalty to his mistress never
faded. Even as head of the house, he visited
the royal palace every day, much to the
dismay of his retainers.

#s(0.95)#c(12)Aramis
#s(0.75)￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣#/c#s(0.85)
After the war, Aramis attended Gilbert's
coronation, then left the capital, vowing to
help his younger brother in his own way.

By now a master of disguise, he traveled far
and wide to help rebuild Drakenhold, posing
in turn as a mercenary, an actor, and a
sailor.

Later accounts of Drakenhold's restoration
tell of several different men, all named
Aramis.

#s(0.95)#c(12)Primm
#s(0.75)￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣#/c#s(0.85)
Even after the war, Primm traveled widely,
giving her time freely to help people worn
down by the fighting.

When her older sister Hilda devoted herself
to studying pharmacology, Primm encouraged
her and helped her in every way she could.

The Orthodoxy offered Primm the title of
honorary angel for her care of the sick, but
she politely declined.

#s(0.95)#c(12)Hilda
#s(0.75)￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣#/c#s(0.85)
When the war ended, Hilda laid down her
weapons and began studying pharmacology to
help those still suffering from the plague.

Through hard work, she became an apothecary.
Together with her younger sister Primm, she
devoted herself tirelessly to caring for the
sick.

Later histories recorded how many people she
had saved, alongside her sister and her
wyvern.

#s(0.95)#c(12)Primm
#s(0.75)￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣#/c#s(0.85)
After the war, Primm traveled from place to
place, freely giving her time to help people
worn down by the fighting.

Her simple, unpretentious nature endeared her
wherever she went, as did the sight of her
happily enjoying the food offered in each town.

Her journey of service is said to have
continued throughout her life.

#s(0.95)#c(12)Aubin
#s(0.75)￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣#/c#s(0.85)
After the war, Aubin donated every reward he
had received to the people of the desert and
worked to rebuild his homeland.

Thanks to the tireless efforts of Aubin and
his comrades, the region prospered and
finally shook off its reputation as a former
place of exile.

He later acquired a ship of his own and set
off on an adventure across the open seas.

#s(0.95)#c(12)Magellan
#s(0.75)￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣#/c#s(0.85)
Magellan traveled the land in search of the
former members of his bandit gang, who had
scattered far and wide.

After settling his past affairs, he returned
to the desert and turned the gang into a
band of thieves who helped others. Their
reputation spread beyond the desert,
attracting young people who looked up to him
as their boss.

A town eventually grew around them, and
Magellan helped it prosper as its leader.

#s(0.95)#c(12)Liza
#s(0.75)￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣#/c#s(0.85)
After the Liberation Army disbanded, Liza
traveled with Magellan. Along the way, a
wealthy merchant recognized her talent for
business.

She was already an experienced trader, but
when she used the reward money she had
received from the king to launch her own
venture, it proved a spectacular success.

Her success helped revitalize the desert's
economy.

#s(0.95)#c(12)Amalia
#s(0.75)￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣#/c#s(0.85)
After the war, Amalia returned to the Coliseum,
extending her unbeaten record and continuing
to thrill the crowds.

Years later, after she had entered its hall
of fame, a formidable challenger finally
broke her record. Seeing the opportunity she
had long awaited, Amalia set off on a
journey with the warrior who had surpassed
her.

#s(0.95)#c(12)Berengaria
#s(0.75)￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣#/c#s(0.85)
After the war, Berengaria reformed the
Tricorn Mercenaries. The king of Drakenhold
invited them to become a royal order of
knights, but she refused.

Instead, the company welcomed new members
and traveled the world, fighting to help the
weak and stand against the powerful.

In time, there was hardly anyone in Fevrith
who did not know their name, and their deeds
